description: Create a workspace-scoped persistent volume — durable block storage that survives sandbox teardown. Defaults the workspace to the API key's first; override with workspace_id.

size_bytes.description: Volume size in bytes. Must be between 1 MiB (1048576) and 100 GiB (107374182400).

workspace_id.description: Workspace to create the volume in (defaults to the key's first workspace).

name: tenki_create_volume
